sv.title: Minnesord om Gert Glentow
sv.summary: Poeten och läraren Gert Glentow, Lund, har avlidit i en ålder av 87 år. Han sörjs närmast av hustrun Birgit och dottern Camilla med familj.

en.title: Obituary for Gert Glentow
en.summary: Poet and teacher Gert Glentow, Lund, has died at the age of 87. He is survived mainly by his wife Birgit and daughter Camilla and her family.
